title: Applications Development Programmer Analyst I
description:
**posting number**

req27328

  

**department**

global health institute

  

**department website link**

https://responsibleai.arizona.edu/events/epihack-arizona-problem-prototype-one-week

  

**location**

tucson campus

  

**address**

tucson, az usa

  

**position highlights**

the mel and enid zuckerman college of public health (mezcph) invites applicants to apply to join our team as an applications development programmer analyst i (temporary). primary responsibilities include work on i-detect, a one health participatory surveillance platform where community members report health events in people, animals and the environment, for early detection of public health threats. the front-end engineer builds the parts of i-detect that participants and health departments see and use, from registration and reporting to maps and weekly reports. the role works with the product owner to turn user stories into wireframes and working screens.

the university of arizona has been recognized for our innovative work-life programs.

  

**duties & responsibilities**

* develop and maintain front-end and back-end components of the i-detect web and/or mobile platform.
* build functionality to support the collection, management, processing, and visualization of self-reported participatory surveillance data.
* develop and maintain databases, apis, dashboards, user interfaces, and other system components required by the platform.
* translate functional requirements, wireframes, and user feedback into working software features.
* conduct software testing, troubleshoot technical issues, identify and resolve bugs, and perform ongoing quality assurance.
* support integration of external data sources, apis, mapping tools, analytics, and other technologies as required.
* implement appropriate data security, privacy, access-control, and secure coding practices, particularly for community-reported health information.
* optimize the platform for performance, reliability, usability, accessibility, and scalability.
* document source code, system architecture, apis, development processes, testing procedures, and technical decisions to support continuity and future development.
* use version control and established software development practices to manage code changes, releases, and deployments.
* participate in regular project meetings, demonstrations, code reviews, and development planning with supervising faculty and the broader project team.
* incorporate feedback from faculty, public health subject-matter experts, users, and other stakeholders into iterative improvements to the platform.
* support deployment, maintenance, updates, and troubleshooting of the platform throughout the project lifecycle.
* perform other software development and technical duties related to i-detect as assigned by the supervising faculty.

knowledge, skills and abilities:

* knowledge of accessible and responsive web design (wcag) for users with different devices, languages and levels of digital literacy.
* skill in building participant-facing features with html, css and javascript, such as registration, reporting forms, weekly reports and interactive maps.
* skill in turning user stories into wireframes and working screens, including with ai-assisted design and coding tools.
* ability to design for privacy, with clear consent screens and views that show each user only the data their role and jurisdiction allow.
* ability to test the interface with participants and health department staff and improve it based on their feedback.
* knowledge of api design, authentication and role-based access control, including rules for sharing data across state, county, city and tribal jurisdictions.
* knowledge of privacy practices for health data, such as de-identification under hipaa safe harbor, and how to apply them in database and api design.
* skill in designing postgresql schemas that bring together human, animal and environmental reports, including location data.
* skill in building and evaluating llm services with checks for accuracy and verifiable sources before results reach public health users.
* ability to write tested, documented code and to review code from teammates and ai coding assistants.
* knowledge of aws services for hosting and protecting a web application (e.g., ec2, s3, iam and backups), and of docker compose deployments on linux.
* knowledge of security and compliance practices for health data, including encryption, access logs, least-privilege access and de-identification (hipaa safe harbor).
* skill in building and maintaining ci/cd with github, monitoring and alerting, and separate development, staging and production environments.
* skill in setting clear rules for how ai coding agents (e.g., codex) access the codebase, and how their changes are reviewed, tested and merged.
* ability to lead the team technically: set coding and documentation standards, review pull requests, mentor developers and turn user stories into technical specifications.
* ability to plan and estimate work with the product owner in weekly sprints.
  

  

*this job posting reflects the general nature and level of work expected of the selected candidate(s). it is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties and responsibilities. the institution reserves the right to amend or update this description as organizational priorities and institutional needs evolve.*

  

**minimum qualifications**

* bachelor's degree in computer science or a related field.
* 1 year of relevant work experience.

  

**preferred qualifications**

* experience with web accessibility review and remediation.
* experience building interactive maps (e.g., mapbox or leaflet).
* experience with typescript.
* experience with ai-assisted ui design or prototyping tools (e.g., stitch or figma).
* experience building health or reporting applications for non-technical users.
* experience with vector embeddings, reranking and caching (e.g., redis).
* experience with clinical, veterinary or environmental health data.
* experience building etl pipelines for large datasets from multiple sources.
* experience with aws (e.g., ec2 and s3). microsoft azure or aws certification.
* experience with region-based or multi-tenant data access (e.g., data for several countries or clients).
* experience with event-driven systems (e.g., message queues and serverless functions).
* experience leading technical work or mentoring developers.
* experience working with multilingual or cross-cultural data.
* experience fine-tuning language models (e.g., with lora) on health or medical data.
* experience with workflow or big data tools (e.g., airflow, kafka or pyspark).
* experience building dashboards (e.g., power bi, tableau or streamlit).
* experience building web interfaces with html, css and javascript, including a framework such as react.
* experience connecting front ends to rest apis.
* experience building web applications that use llm apis (e.g., gemini or openai) as well as aws bedrock and rag pipelines.
* experience with git/github.
* hands-on experience through jobs, internships, research or substantial projects.
* experience building rest apis with python frameworks such as fastapi.
* experience with relational databases (postgresql or mysql), including query optimization.
* experience with docker.
* experience deploying and operating applications on aws, azure or google cloud.
* experience with docker, linux and ci/cd tools (e.g., azure devops or github actions).
* experience with cloud identity and access management and with securing access to data (e.g., iam, service principals or row-level security).
* experience designing and delivering systems end to end, from architecture to deployment.

title: Machine Learning Engineer | Contract | Remote
description:
**about us:**

working at tech holding isn't just a job, it's an opportunity to be a part of something bigger. we are a full-service consulting firm that was founded on the premise of delivering predictable outcomes and high-quality solutions to our clients. our founders and team members have industry experience and have held senior positions in a wide variety of companies – from emerging startups to large fortune 50 firms – and we have taken our combined experiences and developed a unique approach that is supported by the principles of deep expertise, integrity, transparency, and dependability.

#### **the role:**

we're looking for a hands-on machine learning engineer, for a project based assignment, to help build an ai-powered risk intelligence platform. the platform helps enterprises detect, assess, and respond to emerging online threats, including disinformation, reputational attacks, and security risks. you'll design, build, and deploy nlp and llm-based models that process large volumes of data from mainstream and niche online sources. your work will feed directly into the signals customers act on. this is an individual-contributor role working closely with data engineers, backend engineers, and product stakeholders.

#### **key responsibilities:**

* design, train, and deploy ml models for text classification, entity extraction, clustering, and narrative and topic detection
* build and improve llm-powered features, including prompt design, retrieval-augmented generation (rag), and agentic workflows
* develop embedding and semantic-search pipelines to group related content and surface emerging threats
* productionize models as scalable, monitored services with clear latency, cost, and accuracy targets
* build evaluation frameworks and datasets to measure model quality, bias, and drift over time
* work with data engineering to improve ingestion, labeling, and feature pipelines for high-volume, noisy, multilingual text data
* monitor and retrain models in production, and debug quality issues end to end
* document approaches and share trade-offs clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders

#### **requirements:**

* 4+ years of professional experience building and deploying machine learning models in production
* strong python skills and hands-on experience with pytorch, tensorflow, or hugging face transformers
* practical nlp experience, such as classification, named entity recognition (ner), topic modeling, or semantic similarity on real-world text data
* hands-on experience building with llms (openai, anthropic, or open-source models), including prompt engineering and rag
* experience with embeddings and vector search (e.g., pgvector, pinecone, opensearch, or faiss)
* experience deploying and operating ml services on aws, gcp, or azure, using docker and ci/cd
* solid grasp of model evaluation, including metrics, test sets, error analysis, and production monitoring
* strong communication skills and comfort working in a remote, cross-functional team

#### **nice to have:**

* experience with trust and safety, threat intelligence, disinformation research, or social media data
* experience building agentic ai systems or tool-using llm workflows (e.g., langchain, llamaindex, or custom frameworks)
* experience with multilingual nlp
* familiarity with mlops tooling such as mlflow, sagemaker, vertex ai, or weights & biases
* experience with streaming or large-scale data processing (e.g., kafka, spark, or airflow)
* experience fine-tuning llms (lora or peft) or distilling models to cut cost and latency

**location:**

* remote, usa

#### **employment type:**

* contract

* **applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the u.s. we are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa at this time**

title: Software Engineer
description:

title: Data Scientist II
description:
**company description**

since opening our first self-storage facility in 1972, **public storage** has grown to become the **largest owner and operator of self-storage facilities** in the world. with **thousands of locations** across the u.s. and europe, and more than 170 million net rentable square feet of real estate, we're also one of the largest landlords.

we've been recognized as **a great place to work** by the great place to work institute. and, our employees have also voted us as having **best career growth**, ranked us in the **top 5% for work culture**, and in the **top 10% for diversity and inclusion**.

we're a member of the **s&p 500** and **ft global 500**. our common and preferred stocks trade on the new york stock exchange.

public storage is the nation’s leading self-storage provider, recognized for its iconic orange doors and commitment to delivering simple, reliable solutions to millions of customers across the country. we are expanding our creative team to enhance our consistent and engaging visual brand presence.

 **job description**

at public storage, data science sits right next to the decisions. prices move every day across thousands of locations, and our models help decide them. as a data scientist ii, you’ll be the go-to data scientist for one part of the business: customer and revenue, capital allocation (acquisitions, development and finance), or operations. you’ll be part of their planning, shape the questions, and build the models they rely on.

we’re a small, senior team that works like a startup inside an s&p 500 company. ideas get to production quickly, you own your work, and it shows up in the business rather than in a slide deck.

*what you’ll do*

* **build and own production models.** pricing and elasticity, promotions, marketing effectiveness, demand forecasting, retention, lifetime value and recommendation. you’ll write production-grade python and sql, and use llms, embeddings and rag where they’re the right tool.
* **be the data science partner for your business area.** join their planning, turn ambiguous questions into well-scoped problems, and present results as decisions and dollars, not model metrics.
* **run experiments that change what we do.** design and analyze a/b tests, holdouts and quasi-experiments. set the success metric before launch and report the honest result after it.
* **build once, reuse everywhere.** work from our shared customer and real estate data and certified metrics, and add reusable models to a shared catalog so the next problem starts faster.
* **grow the team around you.** mentor analysts and junior scientists through code review and pairing, and back up a teammate’s business area when needed.
* **own the full model lifecycle.** versioning, retraining, drift monitoring and documentation, meeting our model governance standards before anything goes live.

*what success looks like*

* business partners depend on your models every week.
* your experiments change what the company does, not just what it knows.
* junior scientists get better because of your code reviews.

  
**qualifications**  

* bachelor’s degree in a stem or quantitative field, such as statistics, computer science, economics, engineering or applied mathematics.
* 3+ years in a production data science role, or 2+ years with a master’s, or 1+ year with a phd.
* strong sql and python in production settings, not notebooks alone.
* applied statistics in both frequentist and bayesian frameworks, plus experimental design and causal inference.
* a track record of shipping models that drove measurable business outcomes.
* experience with a cloud data platform. google cloud and bigquery preferred; snowflake, aws or azure considered.
* able to turn an ambiguous business question into a scoped problem, and explain uncertainty and trade-offs to non-technical partners.

*preferred*

* 5+ years of production data science in pricing, revenue management, marketing, real estate, retail or consumer analytics.
* the modern ml stack: scikit-learn, xgboost/lightgbm, pytorch, pymc, prophet, and experiment tracking with mlflow or vertex ai.
* mlops experience: model registries, ci/cd, scheduled retraining and monitoring.
* dbt and orchestration tools such as airflow or cloud composer.
* hands-on experience with llm applications, vector search, rag or agentic ai workflows.

  
**additional information**

**workplace**

* one of our values pillars is to work as one team and we believe that there is no replacement for in-person collaboration but understand the value of some flexibility. public storage teammates are expected to work in the office five days each week with the option to take up to three flexible remote days per month.

public storage is an equal opportunity employer and embraces diversity. we do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or any other protected status. all qualified candidates are encouraged to apply.

\*\*sponsorship for work authorization is not available for this posting. candidates must be authorized to work in the u.s. without restrictions or requiring sponsorship now or in the future. we do not provide training plans or support for f-1 opt, stem opt extensions, or future visa sponsorship.\*\*

title: Data and Analytics Architect
description:
at orion180, we don’t just stand out for what we do; we shine because of how we do it. our mission is to deliver an exceptional insurance experience through innovative technology, unparalleled customer service, and a comprehensive suite of products. our vision is to be the premier global provider of insurance solutions and redefine the insurance industry.

orion180 is proud to call three vibrant cities home. our headquarters on florida’s stunning space coast in melbourne offers an exceptional quality of life, with affordable housing, excellent transportation, and close proximity to major cities like orlando, tampa, and miami. our irving, texas, office places us in a dynamic center of culture, business, and entertainment, keeping us closely connected to innovation and growth. our draper, utah, location, nestled in the heart of the salt lake valley, connects us to a rapidly growing tech ecosystem and provides access to the outdoor lifestyle and natural beauty the region is known for.

**about the role:**

we believe analytics isn't a back-office function. it's not a reporting layer bolted onto the business after the real decisions get made. it's the foundation that tells you where risk actually lives, where growth is hiding, and where you're missing opportunities before it's too late to do anything about it.

that belief is driving real investment in our people, platforms, and in how deeply analytics is woven into the way we operate. from underwriting to distribution to customer experience, we're building a data culture where insight drives action.

it also means evolving how we think about the role of a data and analytics architect.

the expectation isn’t just technical execution. it’s curiosity. ownership. the ability to step into ambiguity, frame the problem, and help guide the business toward better decisions.

**what you’ll do:**

in this role you will be designing and governing scalable data platforms on the microsoft cloud. key responsibilities include bridging the gap between complex core insurance systems (policy admin, claims, billing) and our analytical consumers, implementing data lakehouse architectures, ensuring data governance, and leading cloud migrations and platform integrations. ideal candidates require expert-level proficiency in azure data services and data modeling. you will collaborate with data scientists, analysts, and business leaders to turn raw data into scalable, production-ready assets for real-time analytics engines, portfolio risk platforms, and client-facing digital products.

**data architecture & modeling**

* design secure, scalable, and resilient data architectures using the medallion (bronze/silver/gold) pattern and **delta lake** pattern in close partnership with the enterprise innovation & technology (i & t) organization.
* lead physical and logical data modeling efforts across relational, dimensional (kimball / star schema), and data vault methodologies.
* develop high-performance data processing logic using pyspark, spark sql, and python on **azure databricks** and synapse analytics.
* define data abstraction layers ensuring third-party saas and legacy databases map cleanly to machine-readable schemas for efficient and measurable consumption.
* architect secure, scalable model context protocol (mcp) servers and gateways to connect llms and ai agents to internal analytical data repositories.

**platform & engineering standards**

* establish architectural patterns and best practices for data ingestion, transformation, and pipeline orchestration.
* evaluate, benchmark, and recommend components of our modern data stack in alignment with i & t’s strategy and be an active participant/contributor to the architecture review board.
* work closely with data engineers to conduct architecture reviews and mentor engineers on scalability and pipeline efficiency.
* architect semantic layer solutions and data product structures to power self-service power bi implementations.
* architect high-throughput batch and streaming pipelines to ingest structured transactional policy/claims data as well as unstructured data (e.g., adjuster loss notes, fnol images, aerial and satellite imagery surveys).
* collaborate with data science and machine learning teams to ensure clean, structured feature stores and data pipelines for future ml models and applications.

**governance, quality & security**

* implement automated data quality monitoring, data lineage tracking, and metadata management frameworks across the data lifecycle.
* partner with the enterprise technology and security and compliance teams to enforce role-based access control (rbac), data masking, and compliance standards (soc 2, gdpr, ccpa).

**architectural leadership**

* partner with the i & t architecture team to build and optimize complex etl/elt workflows utilizing **azure data factory** and **microsoft fabric data pipelines.**
* work closely with data engineers, data scientists, and business stakeholders to deploy ai/ml models and business intelligence solutions (e.g., power bi).

**what we’re looking for:**

* **education:**
* bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics, or a related quantitative field.
* united states citizen or green card holder required.

**experience:**

* 7+ years in enterprise data architecture with demonstrated expertise in leading data platform initiatives and modernizing data estates.
* expert in **azure data lake storage gen2**, **azure synapse analytics**, **azure databricks**, **azure data factory**, and **microsoft fabric**.
* strong knowledge of relational and nosql systems like **azure sql database** and **azure cosmos db**.
* experience designing real-time architecture using **azure event hubs** and **stream analytics.**
* high proficiency in **python**, **sql**, **pyspark**, and **spark sql**.
* ability to integrate **geospatial** data types and visualization platforms for location intelligence that removes data fragmentation and technical bottlenecks.
* preferred credentials include **microsoft certified: azure data engineer associate** or **azure solutions architect expert.**

**skills & attributes:**

* excellent analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking skills.
* strong communication and collaboration abilities across technical and non-technical teams.
* ability to manage multiple projects in a fast-paced, results-driven environment

***this position is 100% onsite in our irving, tx location***

we are interested in candidates who are developing capabilities aligned with modern, forward-looking analytics practices. this includes experience or familiarity with semantic data modeling and governed metric layers, working within scalable cloud data platforms (e.g., snowflake, databricks), and integrating analytics within broader data engineering workflows. exposure to emerging capabilities such as ai-assisted analysis, automated insight generation, and advanced data visualization techniques is highly valued.

**what’s in it for you:**

**join our team & make an impact!** at orion180, we don’t just meet expectations, we exceed them. if you’re ready to take your career to the next level and be part of a growing, forward-thinking company, apply today!

* dynamic environment: on-site role with a fast-paced and collaborative team culture. results-driven office where your contributions make a real impact.
* compensation: competitive base pay and performance bonuses.
* career growth: mentorship, growth tracks, and professional development.
* benefits: medical, dental, vision, 401k, paid holidays, pto and more!

the office environment is fast-paced and collaborative. an employee must be willing and able to work their regularly assigned work schedule onsite, and in times of need, be able to work an extended schedule depending on company or departmental needs, project requirements, or customer demands.

while performing general duties for this position, the employee is regularly required to sit, stand, and/or walk around (including the use of stairs). other demands include the ability to openly communicate with others by talking, listening, comprehending, and reading; being able to lift light objects (<25 lbs); and using standard office equipment such as computers, printers, and phones. in addition, there is an occasional need to bend, twist, or squat down to open/close cabinets and reach for files or other standard office-type objects.

orion180 is an equal opportunity employer. all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status.

reasonable accommodations are available for qualified individuals with disabilities during the application process. applicants who need accommodations may email hr@orion180.com to request assistance.

title: Full Stack Engineer II
description:
**about cencora**
-----------------

our team members are at the heart of everything we do. at cencora, we are united in our responsibility to create healthier futures, and every person here is essential to us being able to deliver on that purpose. if you want to make a difference at the center of health, come join our innovative company and help us improve the lives of people and animals everywhere. apply today!

**job details**
===============

**summary**:

we're looking for a full stack engineer ii who can build and maintain applications across the stack while also working comfortably with data platforms and business intelligence tools. you'll develop features, manage ci/cd pipelines, work with large-scale data in databricks, and translate business needs into technical and analytical solutions.

**key responsibilities:**

*full stack development*

  

* design, develop, and maintain front-end and back-end components of web applications
* build and consume restful/graphql apis integrating with internal and external data sources
* write clean, tested, maintainable code following team standards
* debug and resolve issues across the application stack

*data engineering & analytics*

  

* build and optimize data pipelines and notebooks in **databricks using python/**pyspark/sql
* support etl/elt processes to move and transform data across environments
* perform data analysis to support product, engineering, and business decisions — identifying trends, anomalies, and actionable insights

*llm and ai integration*

  

* independently build llm-powered application features; apply prompt engineering, manage model behavior and token budgets, and design ai interactions that are reliable and appropriate for production use.
* integrate rag pipelines and vector search components into application layers; work with data scientists to ensure retrieval quality meets application requirements.
* leverage ai coding assistants to accelerate development, testing, and code review tasks; validate ai-generated code critically and apply it with the same engineering discipline as hand-written code.
* analyze application telemetry, load times, bundle sizes, and query execution plans to identify bottlenecks.
* translate product kpis or user metrics into technical tracking requirements (e.g., event logging and monitoring).

*devops & deployment*

  

* manage ci/cd pipelines using **azure devops** (boards, repos, pipelines, artifacts)
* participate in release management, environment configuration, and deployment automation
* monitor application and pipeline health; troubleshoot build/deployment failures

*stakeholder engagement*

  

* partner directly with business stakeholders to gather requirements and clarify data/reporting needs
* translate business questions into technical specs, data models, or dashboard requirements
* present findings, dashboards, or technical updates clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences
* collaborate with product managers, designers, and other engineers in sprint planning and reviews

*quality & collaboration*

  

* participate in code reviews and uphold engineering best practices
* write and maintain technical documentation (data dictionaries, pipeline docs, runbooks)
* mentor junior engineers on specific tasks as needed

**required qualifications**

  

* bachelor’s degree in computer science, software engineering, systems engineering, information technology, or a related field, or equivalent experience required.

title: Full Stack Software Engineer
description:
**job requisition:** full stack software engineer

**department:** information technology

**reports to:** head of ai program management

**location:** remote

**employment type:** full-time

**role overview**

alaris acquisitions serves as a premier m&a advisory firm exclusively dedicated to the wealth management industry. we are seeking a mid to senior level full stack & data engineer to drive the technical evolution of our proprietary applications, including our lens compatibility platform. you will collaborate closely with our internal engineering team and our barcelona-based agency partners, nexus creative, to develop comprehensive seller and buyer portals, webflow-driven marketing web applications, and a robust data infrastructure.

key responsibilities

* **data lakehouse architecture:** build and manage an open-format raw data layer using azure databricks, starting with our initial workspace and catalog rollout.
* **pipeline & data engineering:** ingest raw, unchanged data from google drive, postgres, databricks and n8n platforms. manage complex workflows using n8n to execute on a single data layer.
* **backend & api development:** build, extend, and maintain restful apis in c# on .net core, and work with our agency partner nexus creative we migrate our backend.
* **ai-first integration & data prep:** structure and prepare data for advanced analytics and local-model execution using claude and related llm tools, ensuring continuous feeds for ingesting scripts and vector storage.
* **security & governance:** implement strict role-based access controls to guarantee that buyer, seller, and internal data remain completely isolated. ensure robust data lineage so that every fact traces back to its source file. so when we access data only data the user has access to is visible.
* **portal development:** architect and optimize dynamic buyer and seller portals on azure app service, ensuring a premium front-end ui/ux for our wealth management clientele.
* **strategic execution:** operate within our entrepreneurial operating system (eos) framework, taking ownership of q4 rocks, maintaining our weekly scorecard, and presenting key stage 2 architecture decisions on the level 10 (l10) meeting list. align all engineering deliverables with our enterprise it transformation roadmap (txrm).

technical requirements & experience

* **core full-stack & backend (4+ years):** 4+ years of professional full-stack development experience building secure web applications, including 2+ years of dedicated experience utilizing .net core for scalable backend architecture.
* **cloud infrastructure (3+ years):** 3+ years of hands-on experience within the azure ecosystem, prominently featuring azure app service and azure databricks. cumulative multi-cloud experience (including google cloud and aws) is highly desired and considered a strong plus.
* **data engineering (3+ years):** proven experience building scalable etl/elt pipelines using databricks, pyspark, and a deep understanding of delta lake architecture and managing open file formats.
* **front-end & cms (3+ years):** front-end expertise in modern javascript/typescript frameworks (react, vue, or similar), alongside proven experience managing and integrating webflow into broader custom application ecosystems.
* **workflow automation (2+ years highly desired):** extensive experience building and maintaining advanced automation workflows specifically using n8n to centralize and execute data matching.
* **ai-first & vector integration (1+ years):** applied experience with ai-first development methodologies, utilizing claude and related llms/tools to build out vector databases and power localized models.
* **governance & compliance:** experience structuring data catalogs (familiarity with classification standard v3.0 is a plus) and implementing complex data lineage and role-based access.
* **rag development:** we are seeking a generative ai engineer to design and scale production-ready retrieval-augmented generation (rag) systems and agentic workflows. the ideal candidate must have hands-on experience optimizing vector databases (such as pinecone, milvus, or qdrant) and orchestration frameworks like langchain or llamaindex.

ideal candidate profile

* you are highly autonomous and comfortable stepping into a lean, fast-paced technical team to take ownership of both front-end features and major backend architectural shifts.
* you understand how to balance rapid feature deployment for marketing initiatives with the rigorous data security requirements inherent in financial services m&a.
* you communicate effectively across disciplines, translating complex data engineering realities to executive leadership and collaborating seamlessly with international creative partners.

* comprehensive health, dental, and vision benefits
* 401(k)
* 100% remote, some occasional travel
* professional development and certification support

at solstice advanced materials, we are committed to offering the highest value-add specialty solutions in the advanced materials sector. our goal is to solve our customers' most complex challenges through a robust and innovative product portfolio and by doing so, deliver exceptional value to our stakeholders. we have identified actionable strategies to grow by expanding into new products and markets and through strategic acquisitions, while keeping our top operating margins.

joining our team means becoming part of an organization which leverages its long-standing reputation to capture growth trends by investing in innovation and manufacturing enhancements and maintaining deep customer relationships.

we foster a collaborative and inclusive work environment that values contributions and supports professional development. with a focus on innovation and sustainability, the team is dedicated to delivering value and making a meaningful impact in advancing our customers' success. let’s make that impact together.

as a sr advanced r& d engineer/scientist you will develop and apply statistical, machine learning, and scientific modeling methods to accelerate materials discovery, product development, and manufacturing optimization. the role will partner closely with scientists and engineers to transform experimental and process data into validated models, actionable insights, and scalable r&d capabilities. this position is available in morris plains, nj, or buffalo, ny.

  

**about solstice advanced materials**

solstice advanced materials is a leading global specialty materials company that advances science for smarter outcomes. solstice offers high-performance solutions that enable critical industries and applications, including refrigerants, semiconductor manufacturing, data center cooling, nuclear power, protective fibers, healthcare packaging and more. solstice is recognized for developing next-generation materials through some of the industry's most renowned brands such as solstice®, genetron®, aclar®, spectra®, fluka™, and hydranal™. partnering with over 3,000 customers across more than 120 countries and territories and supported by a robust portfolio of over 5,700 patents, solstice’s approximately 4,000 employees worldwide drive innovation in materials science. for more information, visit advanced materials .

  

**key responsibilities**

* **-** analyze complex experimental, analytical, and manufacturing datasets using statistical and machine learning methods to identify trends, patterns, and relationships.
* **-** develop and validate predictive models to improve material performance, evaluate the effects of key variables, and support product and process development.
* **-** partner with chemists, materials scientists, engineers, and business stakeholders to define data needs, develop analytical solutions, and influence decisions.
* **-** evaluate and implement state-of-the-art data science methods for advanced materials applications, informed by relevant scientific and technical literature.
* **-** design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines and databases for experimental and analytical data.
* **-** establish data quality practices that ensure reliable, traceable, and reproducible datasets and analyses.
* **-** communicate findings, recommendations, and technical limitations through clear visualizations, reports, and presentations for technical and non-technical audiences.

  

**must have**

* master’s or ph.d. in data science, materials science, statistics, applied mathematics, or a related field.
* minimum of 5 years of experience in data analysis or data science roles within a materials science or engineering domain.
* proficiency in programming languages such as python and familiarity with data manipulation libraries relevant to chemistry and materials (e.g., rdkit).
* experience developing physics-informed neural networks, surrogate models, cheminformatics models, or quantitative structure–property relationship models.
* strong understanding of statistical modeling, machine learning algorithms, and data visualization techniques.
* experience with data visualization tools or packages (e.g., tableau, power bi, origin, matplotlib, seaborn) and databases (e.g., sql, nosql).

**we value**

* deep knowledge of advanced materials, including polymers, nanomaterials, ceramics, metals, small molecules, formulations, or composites.
* familiarity with experimental methods in materials characterization and testing.
* familiarity with chemical manufacturing processes, process modeling, and process optimization.
* excellent problem-solving abilities and critical thinking skills.
* strong interpersonal and communication skills, capable of engaging with technical and non-technical audiences.
* ability to work independently and manage multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.
* commitment to continuous learning in data science and materials science.

title: Senior Business Data Analyst
description:
at siemens, we help organizations transform maintenance and operations through connected insights, ai-powered technology, and intelligent asset management solutions. our software enables customers to manage the full lifecycle of assets, facilities, and infrastructure while improving efficiency, reducing risk, and optimizing long-term investments. by connecting data, people, and processes, we empower organizations to make smarter decisions, maximize asset performance, and achieve more resilient operations.

**description**

the **senior business data analyst** translates business needs into scalable, high-quality data and analytics solutions.

this is a hands-on senior analytics role combining strong business ownership with technical depth. you will work directly with stakeholders to understand business problems, clarify outcomes and requirements, investigate data, generate insights, and deliver analytical products from discovery through implementation.

you will join the smart infrastructure, asset management software information technology (si ams it) data & ai team and work across sales, marketing, customer success, finance, and other commercial functions. marketing will be an important area of focus, making previous experience in marketing analytics or related commercial domains particularly valuable.

the role offers significant ownership and visibility within a small, collaborative data & ai team. you will work with modern technologies including snowflake, dbt, sql, python, power bi, and qlik, while contributing to the continued evolution of our analytics, data products, and ai capabilities. we expect you to be an early adopter of generative ai, using it to accelerate delivery and expand into adjacent technical areas.

this role is ideal for an experienced analyst who enjoys owning the full analytics lifecycle, from understanding business problems and defining requirements through data modeling, analysis, visualization, and stakeholder adoption.

**you’ll make an impact by**

**business partnership and requirements engineering**

* partner with business stakeholders to understand problems, desired outcomes, success criteria, and business value.
* handle ongoing business requests as a trusted partner, not a ticket taker, focusing on the business need behind each ask.
* translate business needs into clear, actionable data and analytics requirements.
* resolve missing or ambiguous requirements and break larger problems into manageable use cases.
* build strong understanding of assigned business domains, processes, metrics, and business logic.
* lead discovery, solution demonstrations, validation, and business sign off for assigned use cases.
* collaborate with global stakeholders across north america and europe, with core working hours aligned to eastern time business operations.

**data analysis and insight generation**

* extract, combine, analyze, and validate complex datasets using advanced sql and analytical tools.
* identify trends, patterns, anomalies, and actionable business insights.
* apply statistical and analytical methods to support business decisions.
* assess data quality, completeness, and fitness for purpose.
* translate analytical findings into clear recommendations for stakeholders.
* use generative ai tools, such as claude code or gh copilot, to accelerate sql, dbt, and power bi development, and share what works with the team.

**data products and business intelligence**

* design and develop dashboards, visualizations, and analytical products using power bi, qlik, and other relevant tools.
* create intuitive data experiences that enable stakeholders to act on insights.
* contribute to reusable data products, shared metrics, and standardized analytics solutions.
* support use cases across customer segmentation, marketing effectiveness, revenue analytics, retention, and predictive analytics.

**data modeling and technical delivery**

* understand source systems, warehouse structures, data relationships, business definitions, and analytical data models.
* create or adapt analytical data models and transformations for individual use cases.
* work with platforms such as snowflake and tools such as dbt.
* investigate analytical data issues and partner with data engineering on production pipelines and shared models.

**end to end solution ownership**

* own assigned data use cases from initial business problem through delivery, validation, and adoption.
* act as solution lead and coordinate contributions from data engineering, data science, bi, ai, and other specialists.
* proactively manage dependencies, risks, and data availability constraints.
* share knowledge and reduce dependency on individual experts through office hours, training, self-service reporting, and recurring metric deep dives.

**data quality and governance**

* apply established data standards, definitions, governance requirements, and documentation practices.
* identify data quality risks and coordinate resolution with appropriate owners.
* maintain awareness of security, privacy, responsible data usage, and enterprise governance requirements.
* support traceability and consistency of important business metrics and analytical outputs.

**this is how you'll win us over**

* 7+years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, analytics engineering, or a related field, or equivalent demonstrated experience.
* advanced sql skills, including complex joins, common table expressions, window functions, and analytical transformations.
* strong analytical and data modeling capabilities, including experience working with relational data, transformations, data quality, validation, and complex datasets.
* demonstrated experience partnering with business stakeholders to translate business problems into analytical requirements and pragmatic solutions.
* proven track record of uncovering insights through data mining and analysis, and applying business acumen to recommend actions that shaped decisions.
* experience developing dashboards, visualizations, or analytical applications using power bi, qlik, or comparable bi platforms.
* hands-on experience with salesforce or other crm data, such as opportunities, accounts, leads, and campaigns.
* experience working with a modern cloud data platform such as snowflake, databricks, azure, aws, or comparable technologies.
* ability to independently investigate business and data problems and deliver analytical solutions with limited supervision.
* strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work independently and navigate ambiguity.

**you'll thrive even more if you also bring**

* experience working in smaller or lean analytics teams where individuals are responsible for multiple stages of the analytics lifecycle, from requirements gathering through solution delivery
* experience supporting marketing analytics or other commercial functions such as sales, customer success, revenue operations, or commercial finance.
* hands on experience with snowflake and dbt or comparable data transformation tooling.
* python experience for data analysis, automation, or analytical development.
* experience with go-to-market systems data, such as marketing automation, attribution, and customer success platforms.
* familiarity with dimensional modeling, semantic data models, and data pipelines.
* exposure to machine learning, predictive analytics, segmentation, ai enabled use cases, or enterprise data governance.
* familiarity with prompt engineering, ai-assisted analytics, predictive modeling, experimentation frameworks, or model performance evaluation.
* experience supporting saas, subscription, software, or recurring revenue business models.

**what success looks like**

within the first 6 to 12 months, the successful candidate should be able to:

* become a trusted analytics partner capable of independently leading complex business initiatives from discovery through business impact.
* build trusted relationships with stakeholders at all levels, from field teams to senior leadership, in one or more commercial domains.
* handle a steady flow of business requests with insights and recommendations that stakeholders act on.
* turn loosely defined business problems into structured, executable analytical solutions.
* deliver reliable analysis, data models, and bi solutions with limited day to day support.
* navigate si ams data structures and identify appropriate data sources, models, and dependencies.
* become a trusted owner of business logic, data investigation, and analytical delivery within assigned domains.
* collaborate effectively with data engineering, data science, ai, and other specialist functions.
* produce clear documentation covering business definitions, data sources, analytical logic, lineage, and solution design.
* contribute to a scalable and resilient data & ai environment through strong ownership, reusable solutions, and knowledge sharing.
* define measurable success criteria and experimentation approaches to evaluate business initiatives, campaigns, and ai-driven solutions

title: Data & AI Analyst
description:
**data & ai analyst**

**the opportunity**  
• data and ai analyst at a growth-oriented energy company
  
• collaborate with senior technical professionals to develop the data and ai foundations that support critical refining & logistics, retail, and finance operations across par pacific.
  
• gain hands-on experience developing and deploying enterprise software solutions in google cloud platform (gcp).
  
• work closely with business and technical teams to understand complex business processes and transform manual, repetitive work into automated, scalable cloud-based workflows.
  
• grow your skills through hands-on work by building real-world solutions as part of larger technology initiatives, with experienced technical professionals providing mentorship and guidance on architecture, standards, and code reviews.
  
• reporting to the director, enterprise data and applications, you will work day-to-day with our senior developer and data architect, to contribute to the development of data pipelines, internal tooling, and ai-enabled automation.

key activities include:
  
data & sql
  
• assist in building and maintaining etl workflows on google cloud platform, primarily in bigquery, with support from the data architect on modeling and design decisions
  
• contribute to data quality checks, validation logic, and documentation for pipelines the team owns
  
• support ad hoc data pulls and analysis requests from business teams, escalating larger requests to the appropriate data resource
  
cloud & development practices
  
• deploy and maintain assigned components in gcp under the direction of senior team members, building foundational fluency in the services par pacific already runs on
  
• learn and apply the team's development practices: version control, code review, environment promotion, basic ci/cd, and infrastructure-as-code exposure
  
• assist with monitoring, logging, and troubleshooting for workflows the team supports
  
• follow established security, access, and governance standards; raise questions early when a requirement is unclear

ai & automation
  
• sit with business stakeholders to understand how work actually gets done today — the manual steps, the handoffs, the spreadsheets — and help document those processes clearly
  
• partner with the senior developer and data architect to evaluate where ai and automation are a good fit, and where they are not
  
• translate agreed-upon business logic into working prototypes, then help harden those prototypes into reliable, automated services deployed through the enterprise's existing cloud platforms
  
• assist in integrating ai components with enterprise data sources and identity/access tooling, connecting the pieces between systems that do not yet talk to each other
  
• contribute to testing, evaluation, and iteration of automated workflows once they are live

collaboration
  
• work closely with a small, lean technical team where your work is visible and your questions get answered directly
  
• coordinate with business, erp, and infrastructure teams to gather requirements and confirm assumptions before building
  
• communicate progress, blockers, and findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences
  
note: this description is intended to give you a general overview of the position. additional responsibilities and opportunities may be identified based on current business needs.

**qualifications**  
to meet the basic qualifications for this role, you will have legal authorization to work permanently in the united states for any employer without requiring a visa transfer or visa sponsorship.

additional qualifications include:
  
• high school diploma or equivalent required; bachelor's degree in computer science, software engineering, data science, information systems, or a related field preferred
  
• minimum 1 year of professional experience in software development, data engineering, data analysis, or a comparable technical role required; relevant internship, co-op, bootcamp, or substantial personal project work will be considered
  
• working proficiency in sql, including joins, aggregation, and window functions, with the ability to reason about query performance, required
  
• proficiency in python for scripting, data manipulation, and automation preferred
  
• foundational understanding of cloud concepts and at least introductory hands-on exposure to gcp or aws (compute, storage, iam basics) required
  
• familiarity with modern ai tooling — llm apis, prompting, or agent frameworks — and a practical sense of what these tools are and are not good at, required
  
• demonstrated ability to break a problem down, ask clarifying questions, and communicate a solution in plain language required
  
• comfort working in a lean environment where priorities shift
  
• experience with git and collaborative version control workflows preferred
  
• exposure to data modeling concepts (dimensional, relational, or semantic) preferred
  
• exposure to bi tooling such as looker or power bi preferred
  
• exposure to containers, ci/cd pipelines, or infrastructure-as-code preferred
  
• exposure to workflow orchestration tools such as apache airflow or cloud composer preferred
  
• familiarity with oil & gas, retail, or finance data types (e.g., retail data, sap extracts, operations feeds) preferred
  
• cloud fundamentals certification (gcp associate cloud engineer, aws cloud practitioner, or equivalent) preferred

**about us**  
at par pacific, we own and operate market-leading energy and infrastructure businesses in logistically complex markets. we have built a team of downstream industry veterans and subject matter experts to lead our organization with an entrepreneurial spirit and a collaborative, problem solving approach. we bring our diverse strengths and motivation to complex markets where we seek out diamonds in the rough. as a nimble, growing organization, we actively pursue new opportunities with corporate financing know-how, respond to local market demands, and adapt to changing external environments.

**more good reasons to work for par pacific**
  
  
**unique culture and rich values**  
there is nothing ordinary about par pacific - a niche player in the energy space. and there's certainly nothing ordinary about par pacific employees. we are driven, hardworking, entrepreneurial-minded professionals who love to win. our rich values describe how we approach our work: respect for others, integrity, collaborative innovation, and heart. if that describes you, you'll fit right in.
  
  
**location, location, location**  
because par pacific operates in some of the most beautiful places throughout the country, our employees get to make these places their home and enrich their lives. the office where you'll work is in the citycentre in houston, texas, located on the west side of houston near i-10 and the sam houston tollway. it's a vibrant area of the city with plenty of places for lunch or to wind down after work.

**opportunistic growth strategy**  
at par pacific, we look for operations with strong fundamentals and great employees who can move a business forward. our management team has deep experience in the energy industry, as well as in leading mergers, acquisitions, and integrations of newly acquired companies.
  
  
**focused on the future**  
we are an energy company that has recognized the imperative and embraced the opportunity to begin the transition from fossil fuels. we are developing products that help reduce greenhouse gas emissions.
  
  
**excellent compensation and benefits**  
in addition to a competitive salary, we offer a strong comprehensive benefits package that includes medical, dental and vision insurance, a robust allotment of paid time off, a 401(k) with company match, retirement savings plans, educational reimbursement, and more. full-time employees (and their families) are offered medical (with prescription coverage), dental, vision, voluntary critical illness, accident, life/ad&d insurance, flexible spending account and employee assistance program. employees can purchase company stock at discounted prices through the employee stock purchase program.

**our headquarters**
  
par pacific holdings, inc., based in houston, texas, owns, manages and maintains interests in energy and infrastructure businesses. we are a growing energy company focused on renewable and conventional fuels in the western united states. par pacific also owns 46% of laramie energy, llc, a natural gas production company with operations and assets concentrated in western colorado. our common stock is publicly traded on the nyse under the trading symbol "parr".

**our refineries and logistics operations**  
we own and operate refineries in hawaii, montana, washington, and wyoming, with total operating throughput capacity of over 219 mbpd. par pacific owns and operates one of the largest energy networks in hawaii with 94,000 bpd of operating refining capacity, a logistics system supplying the major islands of the state and 90 retail locations. in the pacific northwest and the rockies, par pacific owns and operates 125,000 bpd of combined refining capacity and related multimodal logistics systems.

we own and operate over 90 retail locations in hawaii under the hele and 76 brands and over 30 retail locations in washington and idaho under the nomnom brand.

description:
**about glean:**

glean is the work ai platform that helps everyone work smarter with ai. what began as the industry’s most advanced enterprise search has evolved into a full-scale work ai ecosystem, powering intelligent search, an ai assistant, and scalable ai agents on one secure, open platform. with over 100 enterprise saas connectors, flexible llm choice, and robust apis, glean gives organizations the infrastructure to govern, scale, and customize ai across their entire business - without vendor lock-in or costly implementation cycles.

at its core, glean is redefining how enterprises find, use, and act on knowledge. its enterprise graph and personal knowledge graph map the relationships between people, content, and activity, delivering deeply personalized, context-aware responses for every employee. this foundation powers glean’s agentic capabilities - ai agents that automate real work across teams by accessing the industry’s broadest range of data: enterprise and world, structured and unstructured, historical and real-time. the result: measurable business impact through faster onboarding, hours of productivity gained each week, and smarter, safer decisions at every level.

recognized by fast company as one of the world’s most innovative companies (top 10, 2025), by cnbc’s disruptor 50, bloomberg’s ai startups to watch (2026), forbes ai 50, and gartner’s tech innovators in agentic ai, glean continues to accelerate its global impact. with customers across 50+ industries and 1,000+ employees in more than 25 countries, we’re helping the world’s largest organizations make every employee ai-fluent, and turning the superintelligent enterprise from concept into reality.

if you’re excited to shape how the world works, you’ll help build systems used daily across microsoft teams, zoom, servicenow, zendesk, github, and many more. you'll be deeply embedded where people get things done. you'll ship agentic capabilities on an open, extensible stack, with the craft and care required for enterprise trust, as we bring work ai to every employee, in every company.

**about the role:**

the agentic runtime team builds the low‑latency, reliable, and secure foundation that powers glean’s ai agents and assistant experiences at scale. you’ll design and operate core runtime services for multi‑turn orchestration, tool calling, model routing, memory, streaming, and safety. you’ll work across distributed systems, production observability, and ml infra integrations to deliver an experience that feels instant, accurate, and trustworthy — while optimizing cost and reliability.

**you will:**

* own impactful runtime problems end‑to‑end — from architecture and design to production launch and ongoing reliability.
* build and evolve core services for session lifecycle, streaming responses (e.g., grpc/websockets), structured tool execution, memory/state, and policy/guardrails.
* design for performance, correctness, and cost: reduce p50/p95 latency, improve tail behavior, and optimize token/tool budgets.
* integrate with leading llm providers (e.g., openai, anthropic, google gemini) and internal evaluation frameworks to improve quality and predictability.
* harden the platform with fault isolation, retries, timeouts, circuit‑breaking, backpressure, and graceful degradation.
* instrument deep observability (tracing, metrics, logs) and create playbooks/slos for high availability and on‑call excellence.
* collaborate closely with product, quality, and application teams to prioritize the most impactful roadmap investments.

**you are:**

* 3+ years of software engineering experience building production distributed systems or cloud‑native applications.
* bs/ba in computer science or related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* strong coding skills in at least one of: python, go, java, javascript, typescript, c++, with a focus on reliability, performance, and tests.
* product‑minded: you prioritize customer impact, clear slas/slos, and pragmatic iteration.
* ownership‑driven with a positive, proactive attitude; comfortable leading projects or learning from battle‑tested engineers.

* experience operating services on kubernetes and at least one major cloud (e.g., gcp, aws, or azure).
* familiarity with event/streaming systems (e.g., pub/sub, kafka), caching (e.g., redis), and data stores for low‑latency paths.
* practical understanding of llm/agents building blocks: tool/function calling, structured outputs, streaming, and model selection/routing.
* strong observability and debugging skills: tracing (e.g., opentelemetry), metrics, dashboards, and production forensics.
* background in one or more areas is a plus: policy/guardrails, multi‑tenant isolation, rate‑limiting, concurrency control, cost optimization.

**location:**

* this role is hybrid (4 days a week in our mountain view office)

**compensation & benefits:**

the standard base salary range for this position is $180,000 - $210,000 annually. compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. certain roles may be eligible for variable compensation, equity, and benefits.

we offer a comprehensive benefits package including competitive compensation, medical, vision, and dental coverage, generous time-off policy, and the opportunity to contribute to your 401k plan to support your long-term goals. when you join, you'll receive a home office improvement stipend, as well as an annual education and wellness stipends to support your growth and wellbeing. we foster a vibrant company culture through regular events, and provide healthy lunches daily to keep you fueled and focused.

we are a diverse bunch of people and we want to continue to attract and retain a diverse range of people into our organization. we're committed to an inclusive and diverse company. we do not discriminate based on gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion, civil or family status, age, disability, or race.

#li\_hybrid

**ai-first mindset at glean:**

at glean, ai fluency is core to how we work and we're committed to ensuring every new hire feels confident integrating ai into their everyday work. **as part of the interview process, you'll complete a brief ai-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about, design, and use ai to drive impact in your role.** feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today — prior glean experience isn't required.

depending on your location, the general data protection regulation (gdpr), california consumer privacy act (ccpa), or other privacy laws may regulate the way we manage the data of job applicants. our full notice outlining how data will be processed as part of the application procedure for applicable locations is available in our **privacy policy**. by submitting your application, you are agreeing to our use and processing of your data as required. us applicants and their applications are subject to arbitration of disputes as outlined in our **applicant arbitration agreement**.

title: AI Engineer – Founding Member, NJ Office
description:
hi, i'm andreas. come build the new nu image® with us.

i'm the ceo of nu image®, and we're opening a new office in new jersey. i'm looking for an ai engineer to be a founding member of it, and yes, the desk next to mine is open.

here's the setup. we're building the next generation of our technology, and it's a small, tight core: you, working directly with our cto, with ai agents as the force multiplier. you'll own the ai engineering and the hands-on code development.

ai agents do most of the typing here. but make no mistake: you'll own the code, not just prompt it. you'll understand the architecture, read every line the agents write, and be able to debug and fix it by hand when they get it wrong. when something breaks in production, "the agent wrote it" isn't an answer. you are the builder, and the result is yours.

and here's the line i care about most: i don't want someone who waits to be told what to do. see a problem? fix it. see a better way? build it and show us. initiative is the job.

if you're the person at the meetup who can't stop talking about your agent setup, and you can also explain what's happening under the hood, keep reading.

who we are

- nu image® is a us telehealth company. founded in 2004, online since 2008.

- legitscript certified, serving all 50 states.

- we're opening a new office in the mahwah / wyckoff area of new jersey. this role is based there, in person.

- home page: https://nuimage.com

what you'll build (with our cto)

- a modern web platform and internal tools that people actually enjoy using.

- integrations and automation that connect systems and take busywork off people's plates.

- ai-powered workflows, plus the agent setups, guardrails and review steps that let a small core build like a much bigger one.

- secure, reliable, well-tested systems with healthcare-grade privacy and security baked in from day one.

what a week roughly looks like

no two weeks are the same, but expect a mix of:

- agents running in parallel on branches while you review diffs, push back on bad code, and write the tricky parts yourself.

- working through architecture and priorities with our cto, then turning them into shipped code.

- whiteboard sessions on new ideas, and turning the good ones into working prototypes.

- digging into a weird bug by hand: logs, queries, a debugger, and some stubbornness.

- spotting something nobody asked about (a slow query, a flaky job, a tool that would save us hours) and handling it.

- showing what shipped, what broke, and what you want to try next.

perks of the role (just for fun; these are about the job, not benefits)

- founding member of the nj office. you'll help shape how it works.

- first dibs on the whiteboard.

- you pick the office coffee machine. choose wisely.

- you get to name the agents.

- the ceo is one desk over, so your ideas get a fast yes or no.

- your ideas don't sit in a backlog for six months.

must-haves

ai (front and center)

- you ship with ai coding agents daily: cursor, the grok ecosystem (including grok bot), and similar tools. you have a setup, opinions, and receipts.

- you're current with today's ai tools and how they're changing month to month.

- you've built real agent workflows: task breakdown, parallel agents, prompt and agent orchestration, and review loops that catch bad output before it ships.

- you verify agent output: tests first, reading diffs line by line, and not trusting anything that just "looks right."

- you keep sensitive data (customer information, secrets, credentials) out of prompts, logs, and tools that aren't approved for it.

fundamentals (you own the result)

- you can build and debug it yourself, without ai, when needed. reading unfamiliar code, stepping through it, and fixing it by hand is normal for you.

- solid software architecture: you can explain why a system is shaped the way it is, and spot when an agent's design is going to hurt later.

- strong php and laravel: queues, jobs, the scheduler, events, and eloquent without the n+1 drama.

- real sql skills (mysql): schema design, indexing, migrations, reading query plans, and writing the query yourself.

- debugging: logs, stack traces, xdebug or similar, reproducing issues, and finding root causes, not just symptoms.

- security and privacy best practices: authentication and authorization, input validation, encryption, least privilege, owasp top risks, secrets handling.

the rest of the stack

- vue and tailwind on the front end.

- rest apis: designing them and integrating with third-party ones.

- redis for queues, caching, and locks.

- cloud experience (aws a plus).

- testing with pest or phpunit.

- ci/cd with github actions or similar.

- admin panel tools like laravel nova or filament.

how you work

- initiative. you find the work instead of waiting for it.

- ownership. if you shipped it (or your agents did), it's yours to understand, fix, and improve.

- you work well in a small core: direct with our cto, clear about your reasoning, and happy to explain it to an agent or to a person.

- you can show real, shipped work. we care about what you can do, not a years-of-experience number.

- you can commute to the mahwah / wyckoff area and want to be in the office.

nice-to-haves

- infrastructure as code (terraform, aws cdk, pulumi, or similar).

- observability: structured logs, metrics, tracing, and alerts.

- you've built your own mcp servers, agent tools, or custom agent integrations.

- evals for prompts and agents.

- laravel horizon, octane, pulse, or reverb.

- threat modeling and secrets management beyond the basics.

- open-source work, side projects, or talks at meetups.

how to apply

email jobs@nuimagemedical.com with the subject line "ai engineer – nj" and include:

1. your github, portfolio, or anything you've shipped that we can look at.

2. a short note (a few paragraphs is perfect) on the coolest thing you've built with ai agents. what it did, how you set up the agents, what went wrong, and how you fixed it. this is the part i'll read first.

3. where you're based.

no cover-letter templates, please. write it the way you'd explain it to a friend.

nu image medical, inc. is an equal opportunity employer. we consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law.

pay: $75,000.00 - $105,000.00 per year

work location: in person

description:
**overview**

we are seeking a highly skilled and innovative senior ai engineer to join our dynamic team. in this role, you will lead the development and deployment of cutting-edge artificial intelligence solutions that drive business insights and operational excellence. your expertise will empower us to harness the full potential of big data systems, machine learning frameworks, and natural language processing to create scalable, impactful ai models. this is an exciting opportunity for a passionate professional eager to shape the future of ai technology through advanced statistical modeling, generative ai, and cloud-based machine learning services.

**responsibilities**

* design, develop, and optimize ai models using frameworks such as tensorflow, spark mllib, and other machine learning tools.
* lead model training, evaluation, and deployment processes across cloud platforms like aws and integrated big data systems such as hadoop and spark.
* implement unsupervised learning techniques and predictive modeling analysis to extract meaningful insights from large datasets.
* collaborate with cross-functional teams to develop natural language processing applications and generative ai solutions that enhance user engagement.
* conduct statistical analysis for research purposes, ensuring rigorous validation of models through statistical analysis tools like sas and r.
* develop scalable data pipelines using etl processes with talend or bash scripting to support data mining and analytics initiatives.
* design and maintain sql databases and data warehouses for efficient data storage, retrieval, and management aligned with best practices in database design.
* evaluate ai models continuously for accuracy, robustness, and scalability while deploying them into production environments with model deployment techniques.

**skills**

* extensive experience with aws cloud services for machine learning model hosting and management.
* proficiency in python, java, c, sql, r, vba, bash (unix shell), and other programming languages relevant to ai development.
* deep understanding of big data systems including hadoop, spark implementation, and data analytics frameworks like looker.
* strong background in statistical modeling, statistical analysis tools, and statistical analysis for research applications.
* hands-on experience with machine learning frameworks such as tensorflow, spark mllib, and other ai/ml libraries.
* knowledge of natural language processing (nlp), generative ai techniques, and ai implementation strategies for diverse applications.
* ability to design scalable architectures that support high-volume data mining and predictive modeling analysis.
* familiarity with machine learning cloud services for model training, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring at scale.
* experience working with sql databases and designing efficient database schemas for large datasets.
* strong problem-solving skills combined with excellent communication abilities to translate complex technical concepts into actionable insights.

join us in pushing the boundaries of artificial intelligence! bring your expertise in big data systems, machine learning frameworks, statistical analysis tools, and cloud services to create innovative solutions that transform industries. your work will directly impact our ability to deliver intelligent products and services at scale—making a real difference every day!

pay: $80,000.00 - $180,000.00 per year

* health insurance

* vision insurance
