the state of wisconsin investment board (swib) manages more than $178 billion in assets, including those of the fully-funded wisconsin retirement system (wrs). swib operates at a level more often seen in top-tier global asset managers than in typical public pension funds. swib is a home for top talent. approximately 61 percent of swib’s investment professionals are chartered financial analyst (cfa) charterholders.
  
  
the city of madison, the state capitol and home of wisconsin’s flagship university, makes regular appearances on lists of best places to live, eat, and play. swib offers a modern workspace, hybrid work options, and competitive compensation and benefits.

serving over 703,000 wrs beneficiaries, swib is driven by a clear mission: securing the financial future of those who serve wisconsin. when you work at swib, you know your work matters.

**job description:**

  

***\*applicants on an opt, cpt visa or anyone requiring h-1b transfers or sponsorship into the h-1b lottery will not be considered for this position.***

  

**position overview:**

we are seeking an experienced and highly skilled engineer to join our dynamic team. the engineer will play a key role in advancing our data-driven decision-making capabilities by designing, developing, and delivering scalable analytics solutions that support business and investment decisions. this position requires a strong analytical mindset, advanced proficiency in data visualization and business intelligence tools, and the ability to translate complex business requirements into effective technical solutions.

  

the engineer will report to the data services and engineering director and will partner with staff throughout the organization to deliver timely and actionable insights by leveraging bi tools such as power bi. this role will also help establish reporting standards, promote best practices, and support the continued evolution of the organization’s engineering capabilities.

  

**essential activities:**

* partner with teams across the agency to develop reports, dashboards, and analytical solutions that meet business and investment needs. drive, document, and understand complex requirements and translate them into scalable and effective reporting solutions.

* design and develop impactful and insightful reports using power bi. ensure reports are accurate, performant, visually effective, intuitive, and aligned with business objectives and organizational standards.

* provide technical guidance on architecture, data modeling, dax development, sql, visualization standards, performance optimization, testing, and deployment practices.

* foster a culture of continuous improvement and innovation in engineering practices. stay current on reporting, analytics, and business intelligence trends and industry best practices. drive enhancements that improve usability, effectiveness, scalability, maintainability, and data governance.

* provide support for issues and questions. troubleshoot and resolve complex reporting, data, and performance challenges to ensure uninterrupted access to critical business insights.

* develop and support automated testing, reconciliation, monitoring, and data quality processes to improve the accuracy and reliability of reports and analytical solutions.

* validate and critically review ai-generated code, queries, analysis, and documentation to ensure accuracy, security, maintainability, and compliance with organizational standards.

* maintain comprehensive documentation of solutions, technical designs, business logic, processes, incidents, and resolutions. ensure documentation supports troubleshooting, knowledge transfer, and consistency in reporting practices.

* validate and critically review ai-generated code, queries, analysis, and documentation to ensure accuracy, security, maintainability, and compliance with organizational standards.

* adhere to and promote best practices in data visualization, accessibility, security, development, and deployment when designing and publishing solutions. ensure compliance with agency standards and data governance policies.

* support the implementation and enhancement of automated deployment processes using continuous integration and continuous deployment (ci/cd) techniques.

mentor and support other team members through technical guidance, knowledge sharing, and solution reviews.  

  

**the ideal candidate:**

* demonstrates a proactive attitude toward enabling business and investment decision-making through insightful, scalable, and reliable reporting and dashboard solutions.

* excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to communicate complex technical concepts to technical and non-technical audiences.

* bachelor’s degree in finance, business administration, computer science, information systems, data analytics, engineering, or a related field.

* **advanced experience using power bi.**

* experience using generative ai or ai-assisted development tools to support software development, data analysis, documentation, troubleshooting, or other technical workflows.

* ability to effectively prompt, evaluate, validate, and refine ai-generated outputs rather than relying on generated results without technical review.

* 6+ years of experience designing, developing, deploying, and maintaining analytical solutions.

* general knowledge of and interest in the investment industry.

* direct experience in the financial services, investment management, or asset management industry.

* strong experience with data modeling, dax (data analysis expressions), and sql querying for data manipulation, analysis, and integration within reporting solutions.

* experience designing scalable semantic models and integrating data from multiple enterprise data sources.

* experience implementing testing tools, automated validation, reconciliation, and data quality metrics and processes to ensure the accuracy and reliability of supported reports.

* proficient in conducting complex data analysis, interpreting financial information, and presenting insights to support business and investment decision-making.

title: Infrastructure Security Engineer (Bare Metal & Platform)
description:
spacexai's mission is to create ai systems that can accurately understand the universe and aid humanity in its pursuit of knowledge. our team is small, highly motivated, and focused on engineering excellence. this organization is for individuals who appreciate challenging themselves and thrive on curiosity. we operate with a flat organizational structure. all employees are expected to be hands-on and to contribute directly to the company's mission. leadership is given to those who show initiative and consistently deliver excellence. work ethic and strong prioritization skills are important. all employees are expected to have strong communication skills. they should be able to concisely and accurately share knowledge with their teammates.

### **about the role:**

we are seeking a hands-on infrastructure security engineer to build and secure spacexai's infrastructure from the bare-metal layer up through the platform and application stack. in this role, you will design, implement, and harden physical and private-cloud foundations—servers, networks, identity, and orchestration—and carry that security posture into containers, automation, and hybrid connectivity with public cloud.

this role focuses on securing critical infrastructure spanning data centers, colo, and hybrid environments, with work that may span platforms such as spacexai, x social, x money, and related systems. you'll operate with an automation-first mindset: building secure foundations at the metal and os layer, hardening platforms at scale, and partnering closely with engineering so security is embedded in how we build and run systems—not bolted on after the fact.

### **responsibilities:**

#### **bare metal, data center & network security**

* design and implement secure bare-metal and private-cloud architectures (servers, storage, out-of-band management, bios/uefi/bmc firmware posture)

* hands-on firmware, bmc/idrac/ilo, pxe/kickstart provisioning, and hardware lifecycle security
* build and secure network foundations: segmentation, load balancers, dns, pki, nac, and ids/ips on real hardware

* proven experience securing bare-metal, data-center, or private-cloud environments (not cloud-only resumes)
* hands-on experience with firmware, bmc/idrac/ilo, pxe/kickstart provisioning, and hardware lifecycle security
* strong proficiency with puppet for configuration management and fleet hardening in production
* strong understanding of network security concepts and protocols, including hands-on work with firewalls, segmentation, and hybrid connectivity
* experience with hybrid identity (ad/ldap or similar) integrated or federated with cloud iam
* experience with infrastructure as code (e.g., terraform) applied to physical or vm fleets
* familiarity with containerization and kubernetes security implications, including on-premises or bare-metal clusters
* experience with languages (e.g., python, bash and golang) for automation and tool development
* familiarity with regulatory compliance requirements (e.g., gdpr, hipaa, pci dss, nist csf)
* experience in banking, money transmission, p2p payments, or similarly regulated financial platforms
* proactive mindset with strong ownership, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills
* located in the sf bay area, austin, new york, palo alto, or seattle, or willing to relocate to a us office

### **preferred skills and experience:**

* deep expertise operating and securing physical server fleets, colo, or private cloud (vmware, openstack, proxmox, nutanix, or similar)
* relevant security certifications (e.g., ccsp, cssk, oscp, network or cloud security specialty)
* strong proficiency with python and terraform on production fleets
* deep expertise in kubernetes and container security on bare metal or private cloud
* experience with multi-cloud and cloud-to-on-prem security
* knowledge of ci/cd best practices and tools; hands-on github actions or equivalent
* experience with observability and security operations tooling (e.g., prometheus, grafana, cloudwatch, karma; siem platforms such as wazuh)
* experience building custom security tools or integrations

* experience securing ai/ml and gpu workloads on bare metal or hybrid infrastructure

$100,000 - $258,000 usd

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
**about the company**
---------------------

at swift solar, our mission is to unlock the full potential of solar energy. we believe solar can provide affordable, reliable, resilient, clean energy to virtually anyone, anywhere. but while today's solar technology is good, it's not good enough.

swift solar's breakthrough perovskite-silicon tandem technology will drive solar power to commanding new heights. our tandem cells stack a perovskite layer on top of a heterojunction (hjt) silicon cell, delivering dramatically higher efficiency than traditional silicon alone. in 2026, we acquired meyer burger's hjt intellectual property and manufacturing assets, giving us the world's most extensive hjt patent portfolio and a clear path to gigawatt-scale domestic production.

this vertically integrated approach means we can design, manufacture, and scale next-generation solar solutions entirely in the united states—from silicon foundations to perovskite innovations. our technology enables applications ranging from space solar to utility-scale power generation, creating american-made solutions for a world facing growing energy challenges.

swift solar is on a journey to bring revolutionary clean-energy technology to market. we're in it for the long haul, with support from world-class investors. join our extraordinary team building the cutting-edge solar technology that will power the future.

**a day in the life**
---------------------

you'll build ai products that assist scientists and accelerate our technical progress towards next-generation solar solutions. every experiment we run costs tool time, materials, and scientists' attention, so choosing what to run next is one of the biggest levers on how fast our cells improve. you'll build the ai that helps our scientists make those choices. our systems read scientific literature and query our lab and manufacturing data, then propose experiment plans that an automated optimizer uses to execute them. you will lead development of the planning and reasoning layer, which takes a research objective as input and uses a multi-agent system to guide our scientists and reach goals faster through the best selected experiment campaigns. additionally, we need to measure what works and how frontier models and our own agents perform on problems our team has already worked through, so we can improve the system over time.

this is also a place to experiment. when a promising new paper, model, or agent design comes out in ai for science, you can try it here on real problems instead of benchmarks someone else chose. you'll work with scientists who have spent years on perovskites, who know which questions matter and can tell you quickly whether an agent's answer makes sense. because we develop the process and make the devices ourselves, the data, tools, and people who understand them live in the same company, so an idea can go from your screen to a measured result without waiting on anyone outside.

most of this is greenfield work, and speed matters. you'll get rough versions in front of scientists quickly, watch how they use them, and turn the ideas that hold up into production systems people rely on every day. knowing when a prototype is ready to harden, and doing it without losing momentum, is a big part of the job.

alongside the agent work, you will:

* hold ai-written code to a high bar. nearly all of our code is written with ai coding tools, so critically reviewing the output and keeping the codebase documented and tested matters.
* help keep our existing data systems running, including the pipeline that brings instrument data into our database.
* review code across the team, and help hire and mentor new engineers as the team grows.
* write about what we learn for our public whitepaper series and, when the work holds up, publish it in papers and present it at conferences.

**you might be a good fit if you...**
-------------------------------------

* have 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, including systems that real users depend on
* have built full-stack web applications, with a python backend and a typescript/javascript frontend (react, vue, svelte, or similar)
* have built applications on frontier llms through their apis, such as agents, multi-step orchestration (e.g., langgraph), or systems where models call tools
* can take an idea from a quick prototype to a production system that people depend on
* use ai coding tools like claude code every day, and can tell when what they produce is wrong
* have a cs degree or a comparable record of open-source or portfolio work
* write documented, tested code and are comfortable working in a shared codebase with git
* can explain technical tradeoffs to scientists who aren't software engineers
* take initiative and work independently
* are coachable and comfortable when priorities change quickly
* are kind, empathetic, conscientious, and motivated to make an impact on climate change

**a strong candidate might bring one or more of the following...**
------------------------------------------------------------------

* experience with multi-agent systems, especially ranking, review, or memory between runs
* experience building evaluations or benchmarks for llm agents
* experience designing complex software architecture and leading projects end-to-end without much oversight
* familiarity with bayesian optimization, surrogate models, fine-tuning of open-weights models, or reinforcement-learning environments
* experience analyzing and plotting scientific data
* an interest in science, shown through conferences, side projects, or papers (a science background is not required)
* experience getting skeptical users to adopt internal tools
* experience with sql or database administration, aws, azure, or gcp, or ci/cd
* experience working at a startup

**the logistics**
-----------------

* compensation: competitive package including salary, equity, and benefits
* + expected pay range: $150,000 - $200,000 per year
  + the actual offer, reflecting total compensation and benefits, will be determined by factors such as relevant experience, skills, and other qualifications
* ideal start date: november - december 2026
* job type: full-time
* location: san carlos, ca (swift solar hq), with some remote days possible

**what you'll love about swift**
--------------------------------

* **work with purpose**: join our mission to unlock the full potential of solar energy and make a global impact.
* **lead with innovation**: be part of an extraordinary team building cutting-edge solar technology - growth mindset; culture
* **thrive with benefits**: have 100% of your monthly premiums for hmo / ppo group healthcare plan options and 75% of your dental and vision insurance premiums covered by us. employees also benefit from 401(k) matching, clean commuter benefits, and meaningful equity.
* **invest in your career**: you'll grow your skills, your network, and your perspective at swift. we'll support you in attending conferences and taking online courses, as long as you share your new insights with the team.

we recognize that candidates from underrepresented backgrounds often hesitate to apply if they don't meet all the criteria. if you're excited about this role and believe you can contribute to our team, we encourage you to apply—even if you don't meet every qualification listed. we're eager to meet people from all backgrounds, and your unique skills and experiences could be exactly what we need.

if you believe in our mission but this isn't the right job for you, please explore other career opportunities on our website and email us at careers@swiftsolar.com with any questions. if you have a friend who would be a perfect fit, share this link with them. thanks!

*swift is an equal opportunity employer. we value an inclusive work environment and welcome team members of all backgrounds and perspectives.*

title: Sr. Automation Engineer - IT Asset Management
description:
**sr. automation engineer - it asset management**
=================================================

**req id:** gaq427r222

**about the role**
------------------

as a senior automation engineer on the it asset management team at databricks, you will be the technical engine behind transforming how we manage ~$xxm/yr in asset spend across saas licenses and hardware. your primary mission is to eliminate manual toil and build scalable, ai-powered automation that makes asset operations fast, accurate, and effortless as databricks scales past 14,000 employees.

your initial focus will be on it asset management workflows: automating new hire laptop provisioning, saas license lifecycle management, asset data reconciliation, and hardware recovery. over time, you will expand your automation footprint across it support and operations, including it support workflows, av/vc and event support, and incident response management.

this role requires a strong automation-first mindset, the ability to learn new domains quickly, and comfort building with ai/llm tools. you will report to the senior manager of it asset management.

**the impact you will have**
----------------------------

* **new hire laptop provisioning:** build end-to-end automation for assigning, configuring, and shipping laptops to new hires, targeting a 75% reduction in manual ticket toil.
* **saas license lifecycle:** automate license consumption monitoring, inactivity-based seat clawbacks, renewal alerting, and cost optimization workflows to help drive $1.5m+ in annual savings and cost avoidance.
* **asset data quality:** automate cmdb/inventory reconciliation, deduplication, and multi-device detection to bring asset records to audit-ready accuracy.
* **offboarding asset recovery:** automate tracking and recovery of hardware from exiting employees, reducing loss and improving chain-of-custody compliance.
* **broader it ops automation (over time):** extend automation into it support, av/vc and event support, and incident response management as the itam automation foundation matures.

**what we are looking for**
---------------------------

### **core qualifications**

* 5+ years of experience in it systems engineering, automation engineering, or a related technical role.
* proven track record of delivering complex, multi-system automation projects with measurable business impact.
* strong automation-first mindset: you see a manual process and immediately think about how to build a scalable, reliable automated solution.
* ability to operate with minimal guidance, take ownership of ambiguous problems, and deliver consistently high-quality work in a fast-paced environment.
* we value a great generalist who can learn a domain quickly over a narrow specialist. you should be comfortable ramping into unfamiliar systems and business processes and building effective automation without needing deep prior domain expertise.

### **ai and llm automation**

* hands-on experience building workflows, agents, or tools powered by large language models (e.g., claude, gpt, gemini, or similar).
* ability to design ai-powered automation that handles unstructured inputs, makes decisions, and integrates with enterprise systems.
* experience with prompt engineering, agent frameworks, or ai-assisted code generation in a production or operational context.
* comfort evaluating and selecting the right ai approach for a given problem, whether that is a deterministic rule, an llm call, or a hybrid.

### **automation and integration**

* experience building and troubleshooting integrations between it platforms such as itsm tools (freshservice, servicenow, or similar), identity platforms, and asset management systems.
* experience designing automation for it operational processes: onboarding/offboarding, access provisioning, license management, asset tracking, or similar.
* familiarity with rest apis, scripting (python, bash, or similar), and the ability to connect systems that were not designed to talk to each other.
* experience with data pipelines, etl, or data quality workflows is a plus.

### **collaboration and communication**

* strong cross-functional collaboration skills. comfortable working with it operations, security, procurement, finance, and vendor partners.
* effective at documenting solutions and training peers on new tools and processes.
* clear communicator who can translate complex technical work into business terms for non-technical stakeholders.

### **nice to have**

* experience with databricks, data lakehouse architectures, or sql-based analytics platforms.
* experience with it asset management or saas management tools (e.g., oomnitza, productiv, zluri, or similar).
* experience with no-code/low-code automation platforms (e.g., tines, workato, or similar).
* familiarity with itil processes or it service management frameworks.

**location**
------------

us-based, west coast preferred.

**about databricks**

databricks is the data and ai company. more than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, at&t, bayer, block, mastercard, rivian, unilever, and 70% of the fortune 500 — rely on the databricks data + ai platform to build and scale data and ai apps, analytics and agents. headquartered in san francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, databricks offers a unified platform that includes genie, lakebase, agent bricks, lakeflow, lakehouse, and unity catalog. to learn more, follow databricks on linkedin, x, youtube, and instagram.
